players.product: VCSEL, DFB and EML laser chips and PIN photodiode chips for optical communication (InP / GaAs IDM, 6-inch line); high-power semiconductor laser chips

quarterly_data.quarter: Everbright Photonics results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Min Dayong (H1 2026 results briefing): optical chip prices are broadly stable for now because supply and demand are tight; over the long run, as yields rise, capacity expands and new players enter, price declines cannot be ruled out.

quarterly_data.quarter: Everbright Photonics results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Min Dayong (H1 2026 results briefing): benefiting from continued AI compute build-out, he expects optical-communication revenue growth to outpace the industrial-laser business over the next 2 years; communications, industrial and new-energy segments should all grow steadily in coming years, with optical communication the fastest. In H1 industrial-laser revenue grew with gross margin roughly flat; demand for ultra-high-power special lasers is rising quickly and he expects that area to enter fast growth in 2027-2028. Strategy: a multi-wavelength, multi-material semiconductor laser chip platform aimed at AI optical communication, AI edge laser sensing and silicon-photonics optoelectronic fusion, striving to become a leading global optical chip company.
quarterly_data.figure: ultra-high-power special lasers expected to enter fast growth in 2027-2028

quarterly_data.quarter: Everbright Photonics results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results briefing: board secretary Zhang Yinhong said overseas expansion runs mainly through optical-module makers into overseas customers, while the company also engages overseas end customers directly to show its core technology; it has made contact with all mainstream end customers, and with the module makers' recommendations customer awareness is gradually rising. Chairman Min Dayong said the silicon-photonics investment in Suzhou Xingyao Photonics Technology is meant to pair with CW light sources to give customers matched solutions and pave the way for future CW laser sales; the silicon photonics line is progressing smoothly toward line connection at the end of 2026 and production in 2027.
